profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer | CCM · CXM · Digital Solutions | Quadient Inspire Specialist | Enterprise Solutions · Multi-channel Communications
profile.summary:
Eighteen years building the Quadient Inspire platform from the vendor side — now applying that depth in-house at Optum, engineering the customer communications infrastructure behind healthcare member experiences at scale.

As a Principal Consultant at Quadient, I architected and delivered enterprise CCM/CXM implementations for clients across eight countries — high-volume batch document generation, real-time interactive communications, cloud-native architectures, and multi-channel digital delivery. I now bring that platform-level knowledge to the other side of the table, developing and maintaining the Groovy logic, composition templates, and shared components that power production communications in a regulated healthcare environment.

What I do:

• Develop and maintain Groovy scripts, business logic, templates, and shared data-alignment components across CCM compositions
• Design variable data documents — regulatory notices, statements, personalized correspondence, and compliance-driven member communications
• Build integrations connecting Inspire with enterprise applications, databases (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL), and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS)
• Deploy and optimize Inspire across containerized (Docker · Kubernetes), clustered high-availability, and failover configurations
• Troubleshoot the full pipeline: composition builds, routing and orchestration logic, variance detection, and batch/job processing
• Serve as a technical resource for onboarding teams — tooling, processes, template operations, and playbook development

Technical depth:

• Inspire Suite: Designer · Content Manager · Automation · Interactive · Scaler · Connect · Approval · Email Gateway · Quadient Cloud Services · Dynamic Communications · iForms · Compare · Adapt
• Languages & Dev: Groovy · JavaScript · TypeScript · Node.js · Express.js · Python · Java · PL/SQL
• Infrastructure: Linux · Docker · Kubernetes · Vagrant · Azure · AWS · Ansible
• Databases: Oracle · SQL Server · MySQL · PostgreSQL

Bilingual (English/Spanish), with delivery experience across the USA, Mexico, Canada, UK, Guatemala, Colombia, Spain, Puerto Rico, and Ecuador.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Design, develop, and maintain Groovy scripts, Quadient business logic, templates, and shared data-alignment components used across all CCM compositions.
• Lead communication onboarding end to end. Setup configuration, data mapping, template build, and application of standardized composition patterns for consistency and reuse.
• Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered solutions to address complex business challenges with emphasis on responsible use of AI.
• Partner with Technical Product Owners, business stakeholders, and implementation teams to translate business requirements into reusable, scalable technical solutions.
• Drive production readiness through communication reviews, approval cycles, and release validation, ensuring only fully verified communications reach live customer channels.
• Resolve complex issues across the full pipeline — composition build failures, routing and orchestration logic defects, variance detection failures, and batch/job processing problems.
• Serve as a floating technical resource across the org, onboarding and training new implementation teams on tooling, processes, and template operations.
• Advance platform maturity through documentation, playbook refinement, and continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen stability, reuse, and delivery velocity.

positions.title: Principal Consultant Professional Services
positions.description:
• Scope, architect, and deliver enterprise CCM/CXM solutions using Quadient Inspire Flex, Evolve, iForms, Compare and Adapt.
• Design and develop complex variable data documents across industries: financial statements, transpromo, invoices, regulatory notices, and personalized multi-channel correspondence.
• Lead enterprise integrations connecting Inspire with third-party applications, REST APIs, and databases (Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL).
• Deploy and optimize Inspire implementations across cloud (Azure, AWS) and on-premises environments, including containerized deployments (Docker · Kubernetes), clustered high-availability, and failover configurations.
• Drive performance validation using industry-standard load testing and monitoring tooling, architecting solutions for high-throughput batch and real-time production environments.
• Engage directly with clients at senior and C-suite levels to translate business objectives into production-ready CCM strategies and delivery roadmaps.
• Lead application installations, infrastructure architecture reviews, and environment configuration for enterprise customers.
• Deliver training programs covering Inspire administration, configuration, and development for client teams.
• Define and improve business processes, evaluate emerging technologies, and contribute to internal delivery methodology.
• Investigate and prototype new solution approaches to address complex client communication challenges.
